optimizedContext.value:
# Lifecycle Verdict

## Rules
- Domain API: plain exports in `domain/services/lifecycle-verdict.ts`: `evaluateLifecycleVerdict(change, schema, options)`, `projectArtifacts(source, schema)`, `findBlockingParent(...)`, `resolveLifecycleNextHop`; `domain/lifecycle-engine.ts` re-exports. No `LifecycleEngine` class/constructor/options alias. Diagnostics may call `Logger.debug`.
- `LifecycleDomainVerdict` contains predicate projections, effective artifacts, blockers, review, transitions, `nextHop`; never CLI commands. Application `evaluateLifecycle` + `resolveLifecycleCommand` attach public `nextAction.command`.
- One-attempt authority: caller executes matching checks from core:transition-checks; verdict projects supplied `CheckResult` rows. No I/O, effects, snapshot bag, `check.run` fallback, or second availability algorithm. `TransitionChange` fail-fasts `protocol.edge`; `GetStatus` collects all matching predicates.
- `projectArtifacts`: preserve `pending-review` / `drifted-pending-review`; complete + recursive review-blocked parent → `pending-parent-artifact-review`; complete + other unsatisfied parent → `in-progress`; review block wins. Otherwise preserve aggregate. Only canonical states; ignore display `complete-with-drift` / `hasDrift`.
- Blocker fields: `code`, `message`, `isSkippable`, optional `bypassFlag`, `affectedArtifacts`. Active bypass removes blocker; verdict has no warnings. Codes: `INCOMPLETE_ARTIFACT`, `ARTIFACT_DRIFT`, `REVIEW_REQUIRED`, `PENDING_PARENT_REVIEW`, `INCOMPLETE_TASKS`, `OVERLAP_CONFLICT`, `INVALID_TRANSITION`, `APPROVAL_REQUIRED`. File blockers group exact files by artifact. No `MISSING_ARTIFACT`.
- `validTransitions` = `VALID_TRANSITIONS` legal targets. `availableTransitions` = targets whose predicates pass/skip. Includes target requires/tasks, enter-ready deps/readOnly, forward exit-implementing impl checks, approvals. Redesign never runs impl-exit checks.
- `availableSteps` = extras-bearing `schema.workflow()` rows in declaration order, not participating states. Omitted workflow row never removes protocol state.
- `isReady` derives from supplied `workflow.requires`; `blockingArtifacts` uses failed result `details.artifactId`. If target lacks supplied checks, DAG-only requires walk allowed. `isPermitted` means protocol legality only. Only `impl.linksInScope` is skippable by `--allow-out-of-scope`.
- `nextHop`: `targetStep`, `actionType: cognitive|mechanical`, `reason`; no command. Happy path: design incomplete→designing, ready available→ready; implementing→verifying when available; verifying→done; ready missing approval→ready, else implementing; done missing signoff→done, else archivable; signed-off→archivable; archivable→archiving. Review reason `spec-overlap-conflict`→designing. Backward retry hops remain available but never default.
- Application guidance owns command matrix: `/specd-design`, `/specd-implement`, `/specd-verify`, `/specd-archive`, approval commands. done/signed-off with archivable route → `/specd-archive`. Victim overlap review → `/specd-design`; live archivable `OVERLAP_CONFLICT` retains archivable + `/specd-archive`.
- Archiving exposes `archivable` and `designing`. `archiving→archivable` recovery skips workflow requires/tasks. Latest `archive-failed.commitStarted:true` without completed restore recommends manual review/designing; otherwise retry archive or redesign.
- Consumers needing full public answer use application `evaluateLifecycle`; transition projection uses verdict; `ValidateArtifacts` / `GetArtifactInstruction` may use empty `checksByTarget` for DAG/next artifact only. No hop predicate execution or global snapshot gathering there. `CompileContext` independent.
- Next artifact: scan `schema.artifactDag().topologicalOrder()`; first non-complete/non-skipped artifact whose parents are complete/skipped; else null.
- Failed `workflow.requires` projection preserves predicate artifact ID in blocker `blocking`.

## Constraints
- Predicate results supplied by caller are sole transition availability source.
- Effects never run in domain verdict.
- Persisted aggregate/history stay on `Change`; DAG-effective state remains derived.
- Approval gates do not rewrite requested targets to pending states.
- Overlap blocker represents live conflicts from archive predicate, not victim review reason.
